who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), joiner lane, D161 loops 2 and 4
what: Every step of a head after a need parsed the item's text again (`lower`) and re-ran its builder from the top; a constant need dropped the whole fill and ran it again up to 64 times.
cost: not measured here; tables/cost.rs `census.made_again` and `stopped_ns` count the stopped steps and their time
cause: the stack held only wants, so all a step made before its need was dropped when it stopped
whys: the builders are straight-line code that return `Why::Need` at any depth; no frame kept their progress
class: a restart where a wait belongs (checker-nine-restart-layers)
prevention: the stack holds a `HeadFrame` with the frame's lowering (built, never compiled); a cursor per builder, then NeedConst as a yield, then blaze-ask's Asker (typeck.md 'Head making waits')
annoyance: write-only lane: the cursor per builder touches nine builders in a 3,000-line file and cannot be written safely without a compile between builders
workaround: step 1 written, the rest specified in order
